problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 10 delivery trucks to transport 10 different shipments across a network of 10 distribution hubs.

Each shipment consists of a predetermined route represented as pairs (Hub, Handling time), where each pair specifies the hub where the shipment must be processed and the time required for handling. The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the hubs must be visited.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (H10, 1) → (H6, 8) → (H7, 1) → (H4, 3) → (H8, 2) → (H2, 3) → (H5, 9) → (H9, 4) → (H1, 2) → (H3, 2)
* S2 follows the route: (H7, 8) → (H4, 1) → (H1, 2) → (H2, 2) → (H9, 4) → (H10, 9) → (H8, 2) → (H5, 2) → (H3, 9) → (H6, 2)
* S3 follows the route: (H10, 6) → (H2, 5) → (H1, 3) → (H9, 8) → (H3, 3) → (H4, 6) → (H7, 4) → (H5, 4) → (H6, 3) → (H8, 10)
* S4 follows the route: (H7, 7) → (H8, 1) → (H10, 3) → (H1, 4) → (H5, 5) → (H2, 2) → (H9, 4) → (H6, 1) → (H4, 10) → (H3, 8)
* S5 follows the route: (H7, 10) → (H10, 1) → (H8, 1) → (H2, 2) → (H3, 10) → (H1, 10) → (H6, 8) → (H9, 8) → (H4, 4) → (H5, 8)
* S6 follows the route: (H9, 7) → (H1, 6) → (H5, 4) → (H2, 4) → (H10, 4) → (H7, 6) → (H3, 1) → (H4, 10) → (H8, 2) → (H6, 1)
* S7 follows the route: (H2, 8) → (H4, 8) → (H6, 8) → (H5, 4) → (H8, 10) → (H1, 2) → (H9, 9) → (H10, 9) → (H7, 3) → (H3, 2)
* S8 follows the route: (H6, 4) → (H3, 4) → (H2, 5) → (H10, 5) → (H9, 1) → (H4, 2) → (H7, 3) → (H1, 9) → (H5, 8) → (H8, 5)
* S9 follows the route: (H3, 4) → (H2, 8) → (H9, 10) → (H7, 8) → (H8, 2) → (H5, 6) → (H6, 7) → (H1, 9) → (H10, 3) → (H4, 1)
* S10 follows the route: (H7, 4) → (H3, 10) → (H9, 8) → (H6, 1) → (H4, 7) → (H8, 10) → (H2, 8) → (H5, 1) → (H1, 9) → (H10, 6)

Each handling procedure must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted, and each hub can only process one shipment at a time. The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all shipments at the hubs so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
